answers.core:
Probably possible to be built as an addon, but since it affects UX it would be best for everyone to get it. Also, it's meant to help create a practical step towards some of the other proposals discussing the future of addons, such as https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1205 

Let me know if this sounds useful or if there's a better way to implement this sort of package management type of functionality that pairs nicely with the other proposals :)

title: Add support for installing/managing addons via Git URL
